By Marta Lindqvist, Transport Correspondent

Ferry service to return after winter repairs

ShareEmailPrint

The island ferry will resume its full timetable on Monday, ending a three month gap that forced residents to rely on a single small boat. Engineers completed the final inspection of the new propeller shaft late on Thursday evening.

Advertisement: Sunday brunch at the Mill Cafe

Council officials said the delay was caused by a shortage of replacement bearings, which had to be shipped from a specialist workshop overseas. Passengers who bought season tickets during the disruption will receive a partial refund.

We waited patiently, but nobody wants another winter like this one.

Harbour master Tomas Reyes described the repair as the most complicated job in a decade. He praised the crew for keeping the emergency service running through storms and thick fog.
